get.summary: List the workspace change log (newest first)

schema.title: Response Get Changelog Api V1 Workspace Changelog Get

delete.summary: Soft-delete a workspace item (undo with restore)

post.summary: Reorder a section's items (one version bump)

get.summary: Derive the standard resume from the workspace

schema.title: Response List Imports Api V1 Imports Get

post.summary: Upload a document for extraction review
post.description: Accepts a PDF or DOCX (multipart field `file`), sniffed on magic bytes (not the file name), capped at the configured import size. The document is parsed in memory and discarded; only the extracted text and candidate items are stored. Document contents are never logged.

get.summary: Get an import session with its review items

patch.summary: Update a review item (values, status or certificate support)

post.summary: Confirm a review item into the workspace
post.description: Creates the workspace item from the user's verified values and marks the review item confirmed, in one transaction. Confirmed items are User-attested unless a certificate file or link is attached (then Verified). Idempotent: confirming twice returns the same workspace item.

schema.title: Response List Targets Api V1 Targets Get

Attachment.title: Attachment
Attachment.description: Attachment metadata. The file bytes are out of scope for B1 (PRD WS-2).

ChangeLogEntryResponse.title: ChangeLogEntryResponse
ChangeLogEntryResponse.description:
``GET /workspace/changelog`` entry (newest first).

``label`` is captured at write time so the log stays readable after a soft
delete (ADR-013). ``op`` maps the DB ``action`` 1:1, including ``restore``
(an undo of a soft delete), which the frontend enum carries as of ADR-019.

ExtractedField.title: ExtractedField
ExtractedField.description: One value the parser read, with the line it read it from.

ExtractionItem.title: ExtractionItem
ExtractionItem.description: A candidate workspace item produced by the deterministic parser.

ImportItemPatch.title: ImportItemPatch
ImportItemPatch.description:
``PATCH /imports/{id}/items/{itemId}`` body — all keys optional.

``support: null`` removes a previously attached certificate, so the handler
must be able to tell "absent" from "explicit null": use :meth:`patch`.

ImportItemValues.title: ImportItemValues
ImportItemValues.description: Editable values the user verifies. Unset is ``""`` (a form value).

ImportReviewItem.title: ImportReviewItem
ImportReviewItem.description: A candidate item plus the user's verified values and decision.

ImportUploadResponse.title: ImportUploadResponse
ImportUploadResponse.description: ``POST /imports`` body. ``import`` is a Python keyword, hence the alias.

MeResponse.title: MeResponse
MeResponse.description: Authenticated caller identity. PII-minimal: only what the token asserts.

WorkspaceItemResponse.title: WorkspaceItemResponse
WorkspaceItemResponse.description: Wire item returned by the workspace endpoints.

WorkspaceItemUpdate.title: WorkspaceItemUpdate
WorkspaceItemUpdate.description:
``PATCH /workspace/items/{id}`` body — partial (unset fields are untouched).

``deletedAt`` is intentionally absent: deletion and restore have dedicated
endpoints (ADR-013). ``order`` is accepted for parity with the mock, but the
dedicated reorder endpoint is the version-bumping path (WS-6).

WorkspaceReorderRequest.title: WorkspaceReorderRequest
WorkspaceReorderRequest.description: ``POST /workspace/reorder`` body (PRD WS-6). One version bump per call.
